property_summary: For any equal-length accounts and ids arrays, balanceOfBatch(accounts, ids) returns an array where each element equals balanceOf(accounts[i], ids[i]); the mutant that zeroes entries breaks this because it can return zeros when balances are nonzero.
change_summary: Replace the per-iteration assignment to set batchBalances[i] to zero before calling balanceOf, causing returned balances always to be zero.
